newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 finishes at record closing high.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 finishes at record closing high.

text.p: Britain's leading share index powered to a record closing high on Monday as investors overlooked the strength in sterling to focus on fresh takeover speculation, a surge in pharmaceutical stocks and -a bumper sale by chemicals giant ICI.
The FTSE 100 ended 57.9 points or 1.2 percent stronger at 4,857.4, knocking on the door of its all-time best of 4,879.0.

"I think it's down to takeover and bid speculation," said Gareth Evans, equities strategist at Nikko Europe. "The overall view hasn't changed, which is still one of caution because of sterling's strength."
